description: This routine is designed for individuals with normal skin, focusing on maintaining hydration and even skin tone without overstimulating the skin.

morning_steps.action: Cleanse face using a gentle foaming cleanser.
morning_steps.purpose: Remove any impurities and wake up your skin for the day.
recommended_ingredients: Soothing ingredients like chamomile or green tea

morning_steps.action: Apply a hydrating toner to balance pH levels.
morning_steps.purpose: Restore skin's natural barrier and prepare it for further products.

morning_steps.action: Apply a lightweight moisturizer that matches your skin type.
morning_steps.purpose: Provide necessary hydration without feeling heavy or greasy.

morning_steps.action: Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen with at least SPF 30 to protect against UV damage.
morning_steps.purpose: Prevent premature aging and sun-induced skin issues.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate with a chemical peel to remove dead skin cells.

do: Stay hydrated and maintain a healthy diet.
Ensure hands are clean before applying skincare products.
dont: Skip sunscreen during the day, even on cloudy days.
Use multiple layers of heavy moisturizers or oils.
Over-exfoliate as it can cause skin irritation.
common_mistakes: Using too many products that can be too stimulating for normal skin

expected_results.2_weeks: Skin appears more even and hydrated, minor imperfections may be minimized.
expected_results.1_month: Skin texture improves, fine lines appear less noticeable, skin tone evens out.
expected_results.3_months: Visible reduction in blemishes, skin feels smoother with an overall healthy glow.

expert_tips: Patch test new products before fully incorporating them into your routine.
Adjust products based on seasonal changes and environmental factors.
Maintain a consistent but gentle approach to skincare.
